_comment: Backend packs: the release's backends that need a vendor's runtime, which the app installs on first start where they apply (docs/desktop-app.md). scripts/make-feed.py turns each into a feed entry per target whose asset the release carries: the asset is <asset>-<tag>-<target>.tar.gz or .zip. needs_any lists the driver libraries, by the name the system loader takes, one of which must load for the pack to be of use.
